queryName: Beta - Checkout Of Untrusted Code In Privileged Context
descriptionText: A workflow triggered by pull_request_target runs with the target repository's secrets and write permissions, because it always executes in the context of the base branch. If such a workflow checks out the PR contributor's code (e.g. using github.event.pull_request.head.sha or github.head_ref) and then executes it, an attacker can submit a malicious PR to run arbitrary code with elevated privileges. This is known as a 'pwn request'. The fix is to check out only the trusted base branch ref (e.g. github.event.pull_request.base.sha) in the privileged job, and perform any operations on untrusted code in a separate unprivileged workflow triggered by pull_request.
